prose: The super-team returns to analyze the third episode of Moon Knight, in which we meet the Observers from the Overvoid, witness the zodiacal precession, and the cast fixates on their wounds. It's a terra-bull bloodbath worthy of Hathor in this one.
The Marvelous Demystifiers are: Chance Garton, Gabriel (Slick Dissident), Gordan Hamil.
music: Intro music, "The Balance" by Wisdom Traders
